description: Route-map briefs: three complete journeys (3, 4 and 5 stops, with and without totals) and one that names the stops but gives no coordinates.

briefs.brief: Reel for our rail holiday: Lisbon (38.72, -9.14) to Évora (38.57, -7.91) to Badajoz (38.88, -6.97) to Seville (37.39, -5.98). 520 km in 4 days. Atlas look.

Ferry trip recap: Piraeus (37.94, 23.64), Mykonos (37.45, 25.33), Santorini (36.42, 25.43). Nine days, no distance please. Notes for the cards: Ferry from Athens, Two days of beaches, Sunset in Oia. Voyage look.

Our round-the-world year in five flights: London (51.51, -0.13), Reykjavík (64.15, -21.94), New York (40.71, -74.01), San Francisco (37.77, -122.42), Tokyo (35.68, 139.69). 21,400 km over 12 weeks. Night look.
Make a map video of my road trip from Denver to Moab to Las Vegas. It was amazing.
briefs.note: The stops are named but no latitude or longitude is given; the coordinate slots are verbatim, so the writer must report them missing rather than guess.
